pairs.target: dìèrrì xiàwǔ , tǎ wéi dào liàn chǎng shí , liáng jiàoxí zhèngzài shéng nèi bān dèngzi , búshì gěi tā zuò , shì nálái yāzhù dì diàn qiàoqǐ de yìbiān .
pairs.english: The next afternoon, when Tavi reached the practice ground, Teacher Liang was moving a stool inside the rope; it was not for him to sit on, but used to weigh down a lifted edge of the mat.
pairs.hanzi: 第二日下午，塔维到练场时，梁教习正在绳内搬凳子，不是给他坐，是拿来压住地垫翘起的一边。

pairs.target: gěi tā de dèngzi zài chuāng xià , lí nàgēn shéng háiyǒu liǎngbù , tā zuòdìng yǐhòu , sòng yuǎn cái cóng mùxiá lǐ qǔchū zìjǐ chángyòng de duǎn dùn hé mùzhàng .
pairs.english: His stool was under the window, still two steps from that rope; only after he settled did Song Yuan take from a wooden case his own familiar short shield and wooden staff.
pairs.hanzi: 给他的凳子在窗下，离那根绳还有两步，他坐定以后，宋远才从木匣里取出自己常用的短盾和木杖。

pairs.target: dùn bèi nà piàn tiě cáng zài kě tuìràng de xiǎo bǎn xiàmiàn , luǒ miàn réng cháo zhǎngxīn , zhàng shàng de lìng yípiàn zài hùshǒu chù , liǎngbiān de qiǎn cáo dōu méiyǒu bèi mùtou gàizhù .
pairs.english: That iron piece behind the shield lay beneath a small yielding plate, its bare patch still facing the palm; the other piece on the staff was at the guard, neither side's shallow grooves covered by wood.
pairs.hanzi: 盾背那片铁藏在可退让的小板下面，裸面仍朝掌心，杖上的另一片在护手处，两边的浅槽都没有被木头盖住。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn xiān xièxià wàitào , gěi liáng jiàoxí kànguò tiě jiàn de biānjiè , zài yòng tóng yìgēn yā mù zhú biān shì yuánzhuàng , tǎ wéi tīngjiàn mùbǎn qīngqīng dǐ shàng zhǐ dǎng .
pairs.english: Song Yuan first took off his coat, showed Teacher Liang the iron pieces' boundaries, then used the same pressing stick to test each side's normal state; Tavi heard the wooden plate gently meet its stop.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远先卸下外套，给梁教习看过铁件的边界，再用同一根压木逐边试原状，塔维听见木板轻轻抵上止挡。

pairs.target: liáng jiàoxí bǎ liàn dāo jǔ gěi tā kàn , dāoshēn bāo zhe hòu bù , suíhòu pāilepāi zìjǐ yāo cè hé shàngbì de hùdiàn , wèn jīnrì háishì zhè liǎngchù me .
pairs.english: Teacher Liang held up the practice blade for him to see, its body wrapped in thick cloth; then he patted his waist and upper-arm pads, asking whether those two spots were still the targets today.
pairs.hanzi: 梁教习把练刀举给他看，刀身包着厚布，随后拍了拍自己腰侧和上臂的护垫，问今日还是这两处么。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn dāying , yě chá hǎo zìjǐ de hùdiàn , liǎng rén zǒukāi jǐbù , tā tiē wěn liǎng zhǎng , jièchū zuǒbiān duō ràng , yòubiān shǎo ràng de nà yìdiǎn biànhuà , liáng jiàoxí cái jiào kāishǐ .
pairs.english: Song Yuan agreed and checked his own pads too; the two moved a few steps apart, and he set both palms firmly, making that small exchange: the left more yielding, the right less yielding; only then did Teacher Liang call the start.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远答应，也查好自己的护垫，两人走开几步，他贴稳两掌，借出左边多让、右边少让的那一点变化，梁教习才叫开始。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de shǒu bùyóuzìzhǔ wòzhù le dèng biān .
pairs.english: Tavi's hands involuntarily gripped the stool's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的手不由自主握住了凳边。

pairs.target: dìyīdāo láide búsuàn kuài , sòng yuǎn de dùn xié zhe yíngshàngqù , zuǒzhǎng méiyǒu líkāi tiěmiàn , yòushǒu wòzhù mùzhàng shí , zhǎng gēn yě hái tiēzhe lìng yípiàn tiě .
pairs.english: The first cut came at no great speed; Song Yuan's shield met it slantwise, his left palm never leaving the iron face; as his right hand gripped the wooden staff, its heel also remained against the other iron piece.
pairs.hanzi: 第一刀来得不算快，宋远的盾斜着迎上去，左掌没有离开铁面，右手握住木杖时，掌根也还贴着另一片铁。

pairs.target: mùbǎn zài dāo xià tuì le yìdiǎn , tǎ wéi yǐwéi huì tīngjiàn yìng xiǎng , què jiàn nà dào tuìràng méiyǒu zhíchōng dàodǐ , sòng yuǎn yǐ cè guò shēn , dāoshēn tiēzhe dùn biān huá chūqù .
pairs.english: The wooden plate gave a little under the blade; Tavi expected to hear a hard clack, but saw the yielding stop short of its limit; Song Yuan had already turned sideways, the blade sliding away along the shield edge.
pairs.hanzi: 木板在刀下退了一点，塔维以为会听见硬响，却见那道退让没有直冲到底，宋远已侧过身，刀身贴着盾边滑出去。

pairs.target: yǔcǐtóngshí , duǎn zhàng cóng dī chù guòlái , zài liáng jiàoxí de shàngbì hùdiàn shàng qiāo le yíxià , xiǎngshēng bǐ tǎ wéi děng zhe de nà shēng zhuàngjī hái qīng .
pairs.english: At the same time the short staff came from below and tapped Teacher Liang's upper-arm pad once, its sound even lighter than the impact Tavi had been waiting for.
pairs.hanzi: 与此同时，短杖从低处过来，在梁教习的上臂护垫上敲了一下，响声比塔维等着的那声撞击还轻。

pairs.target: liǎng rén gè tuì kāi , sòng yuǎn xiān xiāo qù biànhuà , cái jiāng shǒu sōngkāi , liáng jiàoxí què méiyǒu lìkè zhàn huí yuánchù , dītóu yòng dāojiān zhǐ le zhǐ dìshàng de yìtiáo fèng .
pairs.english: Both drew apart; Song Yuan first cancelled the change before releasing his hands, but Teacher Liang did not immediately resume his old position, looking down and pointing with the blade tip to a joint in the ground.
pairs.hanzi: 两人各退开，宋远先消去变化，才将手松开，梁教习却没有立刻站回原处，低头用刀尖指了指地上的一条缝。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuányǐwéi tā yàoshuō dùn , tīngjiàn de quèshì nǐ xiān zhàn le zhèbiān , sòng yuǎn shuō bùrán zhàng gòu búdào , liáng jiàoxí biàn wǎng pángbiān nuó le bànbù .
pairs.english: Tavi had expected him to talk about the shield, but instead heard “You took this side first”; Song Yuan said otherwise the staff could not reach, and Teacher Liang moved half a step aside.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原以为他要说盾，听见的却是你先占了这边，宋远说不然杖够不到，梁教习便往旁边挪了半步。

pairs.target: liǎngbiān yòu cháhuí yuánzhuàng , sòng yuǎn wò hǎo yǐhòu zài jiè , liáng jiàoxí zhècì méiyǒu ràng dāo xiān pèng dùn , jiānbǎng lüè chén , jiǎo què rào xiàng wò zhàng de nà yícè .
pairs.english: Both sides were checked back to normal again; Song Yuan gripped firmly before another exchange, but this time Teacher Liang did not let the blade touch the shield first: his shoulder dipped slightly, while his feet circled toward the side of the staff hand.
pairs.hanzi: 两边又查回原状，宋远握好以后再借，梁教习这次没有让刀先碰盾，肩膀略沉，脚却绕向握杖的那一侧。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn gēnzhe zhuǎnshēn , duǎn zhàng táiqǐ , liáng jiàoxí de dāo hūrán xiàngxià yì yā , hòu bù cā zhe mùtou , méi pèngdào zhǎng gēn , què jiāng zhàng tóu dài piān le .
pairs.english: Song Yuan turned with him, raising the short staff; Teacher Liang's blade suddenly pressed down, thick cloth scraping wood without touching the heel of the hand, but deflecting the staff tip.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远跟着转身，短杖抬起，梁教习的刀忽然向下一压，厚布擦着木头，没碰到掌根，却将杖头带偏了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn dùn yě gēnzhe dòng le yíxià , yǐwéi sòng yuǎn yào yòng zuǒbiān qù jiù , sòng yuǎn què jiào le tíng , shuāng zhǎng réng tiē zài yuánchù , bǎ nà diǎn biànhuà shōu le huíqù .
pairs.english: Tavi saw the shield move once with it too, and thought Song Yuan would save it with the left; instead Song Yuan called stop, both palms still touching their original places, and cancelled that small change.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见盾也跟着动了一下，以为宋远要用左边去救，宋远却叫了停，双掌仍贴在原处，把那点变化收了回去。

pairs.target: liáng jiàoxí mǎshàng tuì dāo , méiyǒu bǔ qiāo , sòng yuǎn jiāng dùn zhàng fàngxià , róu le róu yòuwàn , shuō zhèyíxià zìjǐ wò de tàijǐn , yào xiē yíhuìer .
pairs.english: Teacher Liang withdrew his blade at once, without a follow-up tap; Song Yuan set down the shield and staff, rubbed his right wrist, saying he had gripped too tightly that time and needed a short rest.
pairs.hanzi: 梁教习马上退刀，没有补敲，宋远将盾杖放下，揉了揉右腕，说这一下自己握得太紧，要歇一会儿。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi sōngkāi dèng biān , cái fāxiàn zhǎngxīn quán shì hàn , liáng jiàoxí kànzhe tā xiào , shuō zhèbiān hái méi fēnchū gè shūyíng , shéng wài yǐjīng xiān shǐ wán lì le .
pairs.english: Tavi let go of the stool edge, only then finding his palms all sweaty; Teacher Liang smiled at him, saying they had not settled a winner here yet, but outside the rope someone had already spent all his strength first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维松开凳边，才发现掌心全是汗，梁教习看着他笑，说这边还没分出个输赢，绳外已经先使完力了。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn jiēguò shuǐ , méi tì zìjǐ zhǎo biéde huà , liáng jiàoxí yě bǎ dāo fàngdào jiǎo biān , liǎng rén zuò zhe shuō gāngcái zhàng tóu piān chūqù yǐhòu hái néng shèngxià duōshǎo lù .
pairs.english: Song Yuan took the water without making excuses for himself; Teacher Liang put the blade at his feet too, and both sat discussing how much room could still remain after the staff tip went off line just then.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远接过水，没替自己找别的话，梁教习也把刀放到脚边，两人坐着说刚才杖头偏出去以后还能剩下多少路。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rěn le yíhuìer , wèn ruò zài duō jiè yìdiǎn , mùzhàng shìbushì jiù búhuì piān , sòng yuǎn jiāng shuǐ yànxiàqù , shuō piān de shì zhěnggēn zhàng , búshì nà piàn tiě zìjǐ wān le .
pairs.english: Tavi held back a while, then asked whether a little more exchange would keep the wooden staff aligned; Song Yuan swallowed the water, saying the whole staff had turned, not the iron piece itself bending.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忍了一会儿，问若再多借一点，木杖是不是就不会偏，宋远将水咽下去，说偏的是整根杖，不是那片铁自己弯了。

pairs.target: liáng jiàoxí ná dāobǐng zài kōngzhōng bǐ le yíxià , méiyǒu zài yā gěi tā kàn , zhǐ shuō fāngcái nà yíbù běnlái jiùshì chòngzhe sòng yuǎn zhàn de wèizhì qù de .
pairs.english: Teacher Liang gestured once in the air with the blade handle, without pressing again to show him; he only said that earlier step had been aimed at Song Yuan's standing position from the start.
pairs.hanzi: 梁教习拿刀柄在空中比了一下，没有再压给他看，只说方才那一步本来就是冲着宋远站的位置去的。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn xiē guò yízhèn , mànmàn zhuǎnguò yòuwàn , méiyǒu téng , cái tóng liáng jiàoxí shāngliáng zài zǒu yìhuí , zhècì búyòng jiè , xiān bǎ gāngcái nà bànquān zǒu wán .
pairs.english: After a rest Song Yuan slowly rotated his right wrist without pain, then agreed with Teacher Liang to try once more, this time without an exchange: first finish that half-circle from before.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远歇过一阵，慢慢转过右腕，没有疼，才同梁教习商量再走一回，这次不用借，先把刚才那半圈走完。

pairs.target: liáng jiàoxí shuō kěyǐ , xiān jiào tā sōngkāi yòu wò le jǐcì , liǎngbiān yě chóngxīn chá guò , méiyǒu jièlái de biànhuà , suíhòu cái bǎ yā mù fàng huí xiá shàng .
pairs.english: Teacher Liang agreed, first having him release and grip again a few times; both sides were rechecked too, with no exchanged change, and only then was the pressing stick put back on the case.
pairs.hanzi: 梁教习说可以，先叫他松开又握了几次，两边也重新查过，没有借来的变化，随后才把压木放回匣上。

pairs.target: tāmen chóngxīn zhàn dìng , dāo háishì wǎng zhàng cè rào , sòng yuǎn méiyǒu zhuī zhe dāo tái zhàng , xiān xiàng kòng chù zǒu le yíbù , dùn biān cóng liáng jiàoxí yǎnqián lüèguò .
pairs.english: They took position again, the blade still circling toward the staff side; Song Yuan did not raise his staff after the blade, first taking a step into the open space, the shield edge sweeping past Teacher Liang's eyes.
pairs.hanzi: 他们重新站定，刀还是往杖侧绕，宋远没有追着刀抬杖，先向空处走了一步，盾边从梁教习眼前掠过。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gāng yào kàn nà piàn dùn , liáng jiàoxí yǐjīng huàn le dāo de láilù , bù dāo qīngqīng pāi dào sòng yuǎn yāo cè , sòng yuǎn de mùzhàng què hái chà zhe yìxiǎo jié .
pairs.english: Just as Tavi turned to watch that shield, Teacher Liang had already changed the blade's approach; the cloth blade tapped Song Yuan's waist lightly, while Song Yuan's wooden staff was still a little short.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维刚要看那片盾，梁教习已经换了刀的来路，布刀轻轻拍到宋远腰侧，宋远的木杖却还差着一小截。

pairs.target: zhè yìhuí sòng yuǎn méiyǒu jiàotíng zài bànlù , liǎng rén diǎn guò hùdiàn shàng de luò chù cái sànkāi , liáng jiàoxí shuō ruò búshì nǐ xiān zǒu chūqù , gāngcái jiù bùzhǐ chà zhè yì jié .
pairs.english: This time Song Yuan did not call stop halfway; only after both indicated the strike on the pad did they part; Teacher Liang said if you had not stepped out first, you would have been more than that much short just now.
pairs.hanzi: 这一回宋远没有叫停在半路，两人点过护垫上的落处才散开，梁教习说若不是你先走出去，刚才就不止差这一截。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn jiāng mùzhàng dìgěi tā , zìjǐ qù ná yā mù , tīng le zhǐ shuō nà yě děi suàn nǐ pèngdào le , bié hǎoxīn gěi zìjǐ liúmiànzi .
pairs.english: Song Yuan handed him the wooden staff and went for the pressing stick himself, hearing this and only saying it must still count as your hit; do not show leniency to me out of kindness.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远将木杖递给他，自己去拿压木，听了只说那也得算你碰到了，别好心给自己留面子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe tāmen xiào , hūrán yòu xiǎngqǐ zuìxiān nà yíxià qīng xiǎng , jièlái de biànhuà méiyǒu bǎ sòng yuǎn dīng zài dìshàng , yě méiyǒu tì tā bǎ zhàng sòngdào duìfāng shēnbiān .
pairs.english: Watching them laugh, Tavi suddenly remembered that first soft sound again; the exchanged change had not pinned Song Yuan to the ground, nor delivered the staff to his opponent for him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着他们笑，忽然又想起最先那一下轻响，借来的变化没有把宋远钉在地上，也没有替他把杖送到对方身边。

pairs.target: kě nà piàn dùn quèshí duō róng xià le yìdiǎn lái dāo , sòng yuǎn yòng shàng le nà yìdiǎn , hòumiàn de jiǎobù hé shǒu , méiyǒu yíyàng shì děng zhe tiě tì tā zuò de .
pairs.english: Yet that shield truly accommodated a little more of the incoming blade, and Song Yuan used that little margin; none of the footwork and handwork that followed had waited for iron to do it for him.
pairs.hanzi: 可那片盾确实多容下了一点来刀，宋远用上了那一点，后面的脚步和手，没有一样是等着铁替他做的。

pairs.target: shōushí shí , liáng jiàoxí xiān jiāng yā diànzi de dèngzi bānkāi , juǎnqǐ diàn jiǎo , tǎ wéi zuò zhe méi dòng , děng sòng yuǎn bǎ shéng shōuzǒu cái qǐshēn .
pairs.english: While clearing up, Teacher Liang first moved the stool weighing down the mat and rolled its corner; Tavi stayed seated without moving, rising only once Song Yuan took away the rope.
pairs.hanzi: 收拾时，梁教习先将压垫子的凳子搬开，卷起垫角，塔维坐着没动，等宋远把绳收走才起身。

pairs.target: tā wèn xiàhuí néng bunéng hái lái , liáng jiàoxí shuō ruò liǎng rén dōu zài jiù wèn , láishí dài shuǐ , bié zhǐ tì dèngzi liúhàn .
pairs.english: He asked whether he could come again next time; Teacher Liang said ask if both were there, and bring water when coming, instead of only sweating for the stool.
pairs.hanzi: 他问下回能不能还来，梁教习说若两人都在就问，来时带水，别只替凳子流汗。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn zài pángbiān jiào tā bié tīng zhè jù biàn dài sān hú , liǎng rén háiyǒu zìjǐ de shuǐ , tǎ wéi shuō yì hú yě méi dāying , liáng jiàoxí yǐ tí zhe diànzi xiào zhe zǒu le .
pairs.english: Beside him Song Yuan told him not to hear that and bring three flasks, since both had their own water; Tavi said he had not agreed to even one flask, and Teacher Liang was already walking away laughing with the mat.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远在旁边叫他别听这句便带三壶，两人还有自己的水，塔维说一壶也没答应，梁教习已提着垫子笑着走了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yán píng láng wǎnghuí zǒu , méi qù zhuī nàduàn jiàn kuài de jiǎobù , dào le chuāng xià cái tíng yi tíng , chóngxīn xiǎng nà shēng hěn qīng de xiǎng , jiūjìng shì zài zìjǐ kànjiàn yǐqián , háishì yǐhòu .
pairs.english: Tavi walked back along the level corridor, without chasing those quickening footsteps; only at the window did he pause, thinking again of that very soft sound, whether it had come before he saw, or after.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维沿平廊往回走，没去追那段渐快的脚步，到了窗下才停一停，重新想那声很轻的响，究竟是在自己看见以前，还是以后。
